text:
helen: Quick heads-up — auditor asked for evidence showing the RBAC change we rolled last Wed that removed broad write perms to infra S3 buckets. They want the changeproof bundle: PR/commit, RoleBinding snapshots, who executed the apply, KMS usage for wrapped keys, and log retention statement. Can we assemble?

samir: I got the PR link and terraform plan, will export the commit and drift diff. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/ops/pulls/3245

auditor_jane: thanks. Also need a short narrative mapping our controls to SOC2 CC6 and ISO 27001 A.9. Make it explicit which control the RoleBinding change addresses.

kevin_oncall: For who executed apply — CloudTrail + deploy-bot show the run. Quick query: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole --start-time 2026-03-18T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-19T00:00:00Z
```
That returns an entry with userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName = "deploy-bot" and eventName = "UpdateStack". I'll paste the actual event JSON snippet to the bundle.

samir: I'll grab the k8s RoleBinding snapshots from the cluster backup: `kubectl get rolebinding -n infra-system -o yaml` — we store manifests in artifacts/rolebindings/2026-03-18.yaml.

helen: For KMS: auditor wants proof that only the service principal `svc:redwood-deploy` used the key to Encrypt/GenerateDataKey and that we don't store plaintext. We have CloudTrail KMS events with CryptographicOperation = Encrypt and API call = GenerateDataKey, with requestParameters.keyId pointing to arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-ef01. Include those entries and also the key policy snapshot.

auditor_jane: retention window? They asked if logs are kept for 365 days for infra account — SOC2 expects 90d baseline but we promised 365 to this auditor. Please include retention config screenshot.

kevin_oncall: Retention is handled in the SIEM ingest rules and S3 lifecycle. Screenshot: https://console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-logs?prefix=infra/&show=retention -> lifecycle rule `retain-365` and CloudWatch Logs retention = 365 days for /aws/cloudtrail/infra. Will export as PNG and include.

samir: Any special packaging requirements? auditor wants signed bundle and hash so they can verify integrity offline.

compliance-bot: Reminder: evidence artifacts must be uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-18/ with metadata `evidence-type`, `collector`, and `sha256`. See docs: /policies/compliance/evidence-packaging.md :thumbsup:.

helen: Good catch. We'll include a README.md mapping each file to control IDs (SOC2: CC6.4, CC7.1 etc; ISO: A.9.2.1 etc), a short narrative, and a signed manifest: manifest.json + manifest.sha256 + manifest.sig (PGP).

auditor_jane: Also please include a couple of sample log lines showing the requestContext.user identity and the keyId field for KMS events — makes verification faster.

kevin_oncall: I'll redact any user emails and include only usernames/ids. Sample line: `2026-03-18T14:03:12Z CloudTrail Encrypt userIdentity.principalId=AWS:ROLE/deploy-bot keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-ef01 requestID=...`

helen: Plan: samir package manifests + rolebinding snapshot, kevin exports CloudTrail/KMS snippets and retention screenshot, I'll assemble narrative, run sha256, sign with compliance PGP, upload to evidence bucket and ping auditor. Target: EOD today (2026-03-19).

auditor_jane: That timeline works. Please @me in thread when uploaded and include pre-signed links (7d).

samir: Uploading artifacts now, will post link when done.

kevin_oncall: Dropping first export here in a minute — will scrub emails and include requestIDs.

helen: TY team — low-chatter request but need to be thorough. I'll create checklist in the bundle so reviewer can tick items. :white_check_mark:
